column4: The  general  objects  for  which  the  body  corporate  is
constituted are hereby declared to be—
to  organize  and  conduct  Sathara  Sathipattana
to spread in the society, the activity of purification of
the  mind  which  is  the  message  of  the  Theravada
Buddhism  by  way  of  organizing  Dana,  Seela  and
to  make  arrangements  to  provide  alms  and  other
requisite  to  the  resident  Bhikkus  Dasa  Sil  Mathas,
Upasakas and Upasikas of the Bebalagama Nagalen
to oraganize religious and cultural programmes and
activities  with  a  view  to  protecting  Theravada
